answer.reason: Joash's one deed in the verses is defending his son Gideon against the men of the city who wanted him put to death for casting down Baal's altar.

clauses.english: defended his son Gideon against the men who wanted him killed for casting down Baal's altar
clauses.quote: Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him?

doubts: JDG 6:11, 6:29, 7:14, 8:13, 8:29 and 8:32 only name Joash as Gideon's father, his place or his burial, so they were not cited.
JDG 6:32 says he called Gideon Jerubbaal, but the verse says only 'he', so it was not used.
